manifest.name: bf16_cast_v6_permanent
manifest.validation_source:
def prepare():
    import importlib.util
    from pathlib import Path
    root=Path('/srv/ai/models/GLM-5.3-Flash-selective-W3-native-int4-310p/indexer-kernels-v6')
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('glm_bf16_v4_helper',root/'bf16_cast.py')
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return {'bf16_cast_v1':module.NativeBF16Cast(root,'glm_bf16_v4')}

def validate(resources):
    import torch
    convert=resources['bf16_cast_v1']
    value=torch.tensor([0.,-0.,1.00390625,-1.00390625,65504.,70000.,1e-30,-1e-30],device='npu')
    actual=convert(value,torch.bfloat16)
    assert torch.equal(actual.cpu().view(torch.int16),value.bfloat16().cpu().view(torch.int16))
    return {'passed':True,'cases':1}
